title: Mecha Academy
tagline: Pilot cadets, giant frames, and trials that take everything
description: Original mecha anime: the learner is a cadet at an academy where piloting a giant frame demands knowledge, nerve, and practice drills that are suspiciously like coursework. For learners who love mecha, tournaments, and training-arc anime.
worldPrompt: An original mecha adventure as a cadet at Meridian Academy, where giant piloted frames only sync with pilots who actually understand things. Each subject unit is a training arc ending in a trial sortie. Original mecha designs, rival squads, a stern chief instructor, and tournament arcs.
